key_features: All-in-One Complete Lunch Set: Get everything your child needs in one box! This set includes a 4-compartment bento box, a stainless steel insulated food jar, a 17oz water bottle, a silicone spoon, a silicone fork, and a stylish lunch bag
Child-Safe & Durable Materials: Made from high-quality, BPA-free, and food-grade materials. We prioritize your child's safety with non-toxic, sturdy construction that withstands daily use

100% Leak-Proof & Secure: Designed for mess-free transport! The bento box has a removable silicone seal ring. Both the food jar and water bottle are also tightly sealed, ensuring no leaks and no odor transfer in the lunch bag

Excellent Insulation Performance: The stainless steel food jar keeps meals warm for up to 6 hours or cold for up to 12 hours. The lunch bag provides extra insulation to maintain the temperature until lunchtime

Smart & Versatile 4-Compartment Design: The bento box features four separate sections to easily organize a variety of foods like fruits, snacks, sandwiches, and veggies. It helps promote healthy eating habits and prevents flavors from mixing

Easy to Clean & Dishwasher Safe: For your convenience, the silicone seal rings on both the bento box and the food jar are removable for thorough cleaning. All components (except the lunch bag) are top-rack dishwasher safe, making cleanup a breeze
